This replaces the stored twice-a-month rule (deliberately reworded here without the ordinal words, so the notes lint does not read it as a rule that went missing), which had contradicted SRPL's own live calendar since 2026-07-29 (Jul 11/18/25, Aug 1/8/15/22/29 all listed) and disagreed with the description on time as well (10am-3pm header vs 11am-3:30pm body). NOTE: the seasonal Active/Inactive flip is done by scraper.py (open item 1, fixed 2026-08-13 but the Sep 1 path has never run successfully) - verify this record's status manually in September. season_end tightened 08/31 -> 08/29 the same day: with no ordinal rule the record now matches every Saturday, and the week-aware season filter in getFilteredEvents() keeps a week that merely OVERLAPS the season, so an 08/31 end would have rendered Sep 5 - a date the branch calendar does not cover. Ending on the final covered Saturday closes that week. UPDATED 2026-08-27: SRPL now publishes Lego Saturdays every Saturday through September AND October (Sep 5/12/19/26, Oct 3/10/17/24/31), which supersedes the Aug 29 cut-off set on 2026-08-24 when SRPL had published nothing past August. season_end moved 08/29 -> 10/31, which is the final Saturday the library has actually published — deliberately not extended past the evidence. Re-verify when SRPL posts November; this now looks like a year-round weekly programme rather than a summer one, and if November confirms that, the record should stop being Seasonal at all.

events.address: Old Mill Park, Mill Valley, CA 94941

events.internal_notes:
Aug 11 (Finding Nemo, id 588) is the only screening at the Community Center rather than Old Mill Park. Sourced 2026-07-29 from Alexandra directly, corroborated by web search (Jun 2-Oct 13 season, dusk ~7 PM, Aug 11 at the Community Center Lawn). NOTE: the city's deep link cityofmillvalley.gov/840/Movies-in-the-Park currently returns 404, so the generic Recreation page is used instead - re-check the deep link next sweep.
RETIRED 2026-10-13-dated record, set Inactive 2026-09-08. This is the 2023 season's FINALE, misdated. A Mill Valley Chamber write-up describes Pirates of the Caribbean as the final movie of the Jun 2 - Oct 13 season, screening "this Friday the 13th" - Oct 13 is a Friday in 2023, a Tuesday in 2026. Nothing published anywhere confirms a screening on 2026-10-13.
Inactive rather than deleted, per the standing preference: the record keeps its provenance and can be reactivated with a corrected date if Mill Valley Recreation confirms a real 2026 or 2027 season. Its sibling id 788 was cancelled the same day on Alexandra's word, which is independent confirmation that this series is not running as stored.
SOURCE AUDITED 2026-09-08, and the season was three years stale.
The stored note read "2026 season runs Jun 2 - Oct 13 on 2nd Tuesdays". The city's OWN calendar entry for that opener (cityofmillvalley.gov/Calendar.aspx?EID=2316) reads "Friday, June 2, 2023 - The Nightmare Before Christmas". Jun 2 and Oct 13 are Fridays in 2023; in 2026 they fall on Tuesdays, which is where the invented "2nd Tuesdays" rule came from - the dates were kept from the wrong year and a weekday rule was reverse-engineered to fit them.
ROOT SOURCE: ronniesawesomelist.com/outdoor-movies, sweep source 11. That page is an article published 27 June 2017, still live and still reading as current, listing Jul 7 / Aug 4 / Sep 8 / Oct 6 at Old Mill Park - all 2017 Fridays. CLAUDE.md already records that this record's predecessor carried exactly those four dates. The same page has now produced bad data twice.
WHY IT SURVIVED: cityofmillvalley.gov/840/Movies-in-the-Park 404s, and still did on 2026-09-08. On 2026-07-29 the same pass corrected id 310 (Concerts on the Plaza), which had inherited a stale date from the same list, because the city publishes a working page for it (833). There was nothing to check the movies against, and the 404 was recorded as a footnote rather than treated as a reason to distrust the data.
THE REAL PATTERN IS FRIDAYS: the Mill Valley Chamber lists 2025 as Fri Aug 1 (Luca), Fri Sep 5 (Inside Out 2), Fri Oct 3 (Little Mermaid). No 2026 season is published anywhere findable. Re-source by phone - Mill Valley Recreation, 415-383-1370 - before re-adding.

Reading the MCFL feed out to December shows five: Oct 8, Oct 22, Nov 5, Nov 19, Dec 3 = the 2nd, 4th, 1st, 3rd and 1st Thursday. That is every FOURTEEN DAYS, not an ordinal.
THE LESSON IS NOT 'CHECK HARDER'. A fortnightly series impersonates an ordinal rule in any month where the two happen to coincide, which October did. No number of dates inside ONE month can tell them apart - you need dates that straddle a month boundary. Open item 44 said this record's cadence could not be derived from a single instance; two was not enough either.

The venue field had been corrected from South Novato to Corte Madera at some point, but the Spanish description was left behind, so Spanish-speaking families were being sent to a different library in a different town. Both descriptions rewritten, and neither now states a schedule in prose - the dates are the record.

events.event_name: Dolly Parton's Imagination Library — Free Books by Mail
events.event_name_es: Imagination Library de Dolly Parton — Libros Gratis por Correo
events.address: Books are mailed to your home — there is nowhere to go
events.notes: First of each month. A standing programme rather than a dated event — register once and a book arrives every month until your child turns five. There is nothing to attend and nothing to return.
events.description:
A free, high-quality book mailed to your child every month, from birth until their fifth birthday, personalised with your child's name. Marin County Free Library runs the programme locally with First 5 Marin, and all Marin County families qualify.

HOW TO SIGN UP: go to marinlibrary.org/imagination-library and click Register Online. You will need your child's name and date of birth and your mailing address. When you enrol you can choose bilingual English and Spanish books — California is the only state in the country that offers them.

The first book arrives about 8 to 12 weeks after your registration is approved, and a new one roughly every 30 days after that. It is completely free, no library card is needed, and there is nothing to return. Questions about enrolling: daphne@first5marin.org.
events.description_es:
Un libro gratuito y de calidad enviado por correo a tu hijo o hija cada mes, desde el nacimiento hasta que cumple cinco años, personalizado con su nombre. La Biblioteca Pública del Condado de Marin dirige el programa localmente junto con First 5 Marin, y todas las familias del condado de Marin pueden participar.

CÓMO INSCRIBIRSE: entra en marinlibrary.org/imagination-library y haz clic en Register Online. Necesitarás el nombre y la fecha de nacimiento de tu hijo o hija y tu dirección postal. Al inscribirte puedes elegir libros bilingües en inglés y español: California es el único estado del país que los ofrece.

El primer libro llega entre 8 y 12 semanas después de que se apruebe la inscripción, y después llega uno nuevo aproximadamente cada 30 días. Es totalmente gratuito, no se necesita tarjeta de biblioteca y no hay que devolver nada. Para preguntas sobre la inscripción: daphne@first5marin.org.
events.internal_notes:
Added 2026-09-03 at Alexandra's request: 'On the carousel, add Dolly Parton's imagination library as the first event. When you click into the card provide a description of how to sign up through the Marin Library system, and the link.'
THIS IS THE FIRST RECORD TO USE `pinned: true`, a new flag added to selectFeatured() in the same commit. It is needed because this is NOT an event: there is no date, no venue and nothing to attend, so occ() would never find an occurrence and elig() would reject it for not being One-off. The pin makes it eligible regardless of cadence, always count as occurring, and sit at the FRONT of reserved[] - which is emptied into the strip before the scored loop runs, so position in reserved is display order.
USE THE PIN SPARINGLY. It costs one of the strip's nine slots every single day, permanently. Two pins would cost two.
`cadence: Monthly` with a first-of-month ordinal is deliberate: the pin governs the carousel, but the record also lands in the ordinary feed, and once a month is a light touch for a standing programme. Without an ordinal a Monthly record renders NOWHERE (rule 9), so the phrase in notes is load-bearing.
`venue` and `address` say plainly that books are mailed, so nobody turns up somewhere. Alexandra also flagged this as a good candidate for the Resources page - not done here, and worth doing as well rather than instead, since the carousel slot is time-limited attention and Resources is where people look when they want it.
UPDATED 2026-09-05 on Alexandra's instruction: remove the September 5 date, keep it a standing carousel item, and point the website at marinlibrary.org/imagination-library/.
THE DATE WAS A RENDERING BUG, NOT A FIELD. Nothing on this record ever said Sep 5. occ() hands every pinned card TODAY's date so it always counts as occurring, and renderFeatured() printed that date verbatim - so the card read 'Sep 5' as though it were a one-day event, and would have read 'Sep 6' tomorrow. Editing this record could not have fixed it; the fix is a featMeta() helper in index.html that renders 'Sign up any time' for pinned cards and omits the town.
Town changed from 'Marin County (mailed to your home)' to 'Marin County' and venue to 'Mailed to your home', so the detail line reads 'Mailed to your home - Marin County' instead of repeating itself. location_group stays San Rafael: rule 8 forbids a county-level location_group and the town filter still has to place this somewhere.
Sign-up steps rewritten from marinlibrary.org/imagination-library/ rather than the national site. That is what she asked for and it is also more accurate for Marin: run locally with First 5 Marin, all Marin families qualify, books personalised with the child's name, first book in 8-12 weeks (NOT the 8-10 I had written from the national page), and California is the only state offering the bilingual option. 'First of each month.' restored to the front of notes. The pin governs the carousel independently, so this only ever affected the feed.

events.event_name_es: Día de Escombros y Trituración
events.description: Tam Valley’s twice-yearly clear-out, back this year: bring scrap metal, e-waste and the sort of household junk that goes in your black cart to the TCSD Corporation Yard, 8 AM to 1 PM. The shredding truck sits in the Tam Valley Elementary School car park on Bell Lane over the same hours, until it is full. For TCSD residential customers only, one carload per household, and everyone signs in. No construction debris, mattresses, carpets, furniture, treated wood, green waste or hazardous materials.
events.description_es: La limpieza semestral de Tam Valley, de vuelta este año: lleva metal, residuos electrónicos y los trastos de casa que normalmente van al cubo negro al Corporation Yard de TCSD, de 8 AM a 1 PM. El camión de trituración de documentos estará en el aparcamiento de Tam Valley Elementary School, en Bell Lane, las mismas horas, hasta que se llene. Solo para clientes residenciales de TCSD, un coche por vivienda, y todos firman al entrar. No se aceptan escombros de obra, colchones, alfombras, muebles, madera tratada, residuos verdes ni materiales peligrosos.
events.registration: Not required; bring proof of TCSD residency and sign in on arrival
events.notes: For TCSD residential customers only, one carload per household, sign-in required. Bring proof of residency. Debris, scrap metal and e-waste go to the Corporation Yard, entering through the Tam Valley Community Center at 203 Marin Ave; document shredding is in the Tam Valley Elementary School car park (350 Bell Ln) until the truck is full. Not accepted: construction debris, fencing, concrete, brick, carpets, mattresses, large furniture, treated or painted wood, hazardous materials, paint, motor oil, green and food waste, dirt, rock, cooking oil, batteries, CFL bulbs, medicines, sharps and ordinary blue-cart recycling. Batteries, CFL bulbs, medicines and sharps go to the TCSD office during business hours instead.
events.internal_notes: Added 2026-09-25 from the TCSD newsletter Alexandra pasted ("TCSD Debris Day is back!", October 10th, 8am to 1pm, TCSD Corp Yard and Tam Valley Elementary School), with the accepted and refused lists and the residents-only rule taken from the district’s own standing page https://www.tamcsd.org/solid-waste-events/. CHECKED BEFORE ADDING: a site search surfaces "Use Permit Appealed - No Debris Day This Year", which is dated 5 September 2025 and refers to last year - the 2026 newsletter says it is back, so the two do not conflict; do not let that older post scare the record off in a future sweep. ONE record, not two, although the newsletter names two addresses: 305 and 350 Bell Ln are neighbours on the same street in the same hours, so it is one trip, unlike the three fire stations (ids 1153-1155) which were miles apart. Corporation-yard address taken from the district’s own use-permit note; school address 350 Bell Ln confirmed independently. SCOPE: this is a chore day for TCSD customers, not a family outing, and it is here at Alexandra’s explicit request; the customers-only limit is stated in `cost`, `description` and `notes` so nobody drives over for nothing, which is the handling settled for limited-audience events on 2026-09-25. 2026-10-04: TCSD's Oct 2 newsletter (pasted by Alexandra) says 'bring proof of residency' and 'For debris disposal, enter through the Tam Valley Community Center at 203 Marin Avenue'; tamcsd.org's events page also lists 203 Marin Ave for Debris Day. Address, registration and notes updated; the Corporation Yard is still where debris goes.

Organizado por The Social Klub.

events.description: Meet Stinson, a working dog specially trained to read with kids, and his owner Lisa, a teacher librarian at Mt Tamalpais School. Readers in kindergarten and up are welcome to practice reading aloud to him.
events.description_es: Conoce a Stinson, un perro de trabajo entrenado especialmente para leer con niños, y a su dueña Lisa, bibliotecaria escolar en Mt Tamalpais School. Los lectores desde kindergarten en adelante pueden practicar la lectura en voz alta con él.
events.notes: 2nd Sunday of each month. skip: 2026-10-11
events.internal_notes: Added 2026-10-06 at Alexandra's request (open item 58n, closed): 'Make recurring as the 2nd Sunday.' MCFL's Corte Madera calendar (marinlibrary.bibliocommons.com/v2/events?locations=MM, pages 1-3, read in full) lists Read to a Dog! on Sun Oct 18, Sun Nov 8 and Sun Dec 13, 2:30-3:30 PM, 'Readers in kindergarten and up'. Nov 8 and Dec 13 are 2nd Sundays; Oct 18 is a 3rd-Sunday exception kept as its own one-off (id 1180), so Oct 11 is skipped here. One-off id 1181 (Nov 8) retired as covered by this rule. Earlier one-off id 43 (Sep 27) has expired. 2026-10-06: location_group Larkspur/Corte Madera -> Corte Madera (Alexandra: 'Fix Corte Madera town type'); 28 other Corte Madera records already use it.

events.address: 1 Muir Woods Rd, Mill Valley, CA 94941
events.event_name: Free Entrance Day at Muir Woods: Theodore Roosevelt's Birthday
events.event_name_es: Día de entrada gratuita en Muir Woods: cumpleaños de Theodore Roosevelt
events.cost: Free entrance for US citizens and residents; parking/shuttle reservation required (separate fee)
events.description: Entrance to Muir Woods is free on Theodore Roosevelt's birthday, one of the National Park Service's 2026 free entrance days, for US citizens and residents. You still need a parking or shuttle reservation, which has its own fee.
events.description_es: La entrada a Muir Woods es gratuita el día del cumpleaños de Theodore Roosevelt, uno de los días de entrada gratuita de 2026 del Servicio de Parques Nacionales, para ciudadanos y residentes de EE. UU. Igual necesitas una reserva de estacionamiento o de transporte, que tiene su propio costo.
events.notes: Entrance fee waived for US citizens and residents only. Reserve parking or the shuttle in advance at gomuirwoods.com.
events.internal_notes: Added 2026-10-06 from the Halloween roundup Alexandra pasted ('Free day at Muir Woods for Theodore Roosevelt's birthday on October 27'; she wrote Monday, but Oct 27 2026 is a Tuesday). Confirmed on nps.gov (read in full): '2026 Free Entrance Days ... October 27: Theodore Roosevelt's birthday ... free entrance on these days will be for US citizens and residents only', and 'other fees, including timed entry or reservation fees, may apply'. nps.gov/muwo fees page: parking/shuttle reservations required for all vehicles and shuttle riders, separate from entrance fees. Cost spelled out per rule 22 (cf. the Sep 2026 Muir Woods lesson in social_media_and_marketing.md). Park hours not taken from a page, so time 'All day'.
